update: I used lodash’s `xor()` which at least made the implementation easier to read

original: hey what’s your favorite way to tell javascript “add this string to an array if it’s not there already; remove the string from the array if it is”

i feel like I’ve written this “toggle the presence of an an item in array” function a dozen times and never liked it. I can make it work with if includes then splice else push… is that really the best way?
